title: Controls feed expressions and write last
teaches: A control is both a document value written to its :target and a binding in every expression. Control writes land after track writes, and an env-only control has no target at all. A non-finite expression result omits that track's write for the frame.
observe: wave follows sin(tau * beat) and spike is 1 / (beat - 1).
At beat 1 spike divides by zero, so no spike write appears.
mod reads depth and sway and evaluates to 0.125.
gain is written by the depth control after the track writes.
